List employee attendance records with employee names (employee__first_name, employee__last_name, employee__employee_code). Optional filters: attendance_id, employee_id, attendance_date, status, attendance_date_from, attendance_date_to (YYYY-MM-DD), search (employee name or code). Pagination: page, page_size (default 10, maximum 100). Results are ordered by -attendance_date, attendance_id. worked_minutes/overtime_minutes are calculated from the employee's running contract schedule.
Create an attendance record. Worked/overtime minutes are calculated by the API.
Update an attendance record. attendance_id is required. Worked/overtime minutes are calculated by the API.
Delete an attendance record by attendance_id.

List employment contracts. Optional exact filters: contract_number, employee_id, contract_type (permanent, fixed_term, temporary, intern, contractor), status (draft, running, expired, terminated), position_id, schedule_id, currency. Date ranges: start_date_from, start_date_to, end_date_from, end_date_to (YYYY-MM-DD). search: partial match on contract number, employee first/last name or position title (every word must match). Pagination: page, page_size (default 10, maximum 100). Ordered by -start_date, contract_id.
Get a single employment contract. Returns {"contract": {...}} or 404.

Create an employment contract. Required: employee_id, contract_type, start_date, wage. Optional: end_date (must be after start_date, null for open-ended), position_id, schedule_id, currency (default EGP), status (default draft). contract_number is generated by the server (CTR-YYYY-NNNN) and returned in the response; any contract_number sent is ignored. Returns 409 if the employee already has a running contract.

Partially update an employment contract. contract_id is required; send only the fields to change. contract_number can't be changed. A wage change is logged automatically in Employee History. Returns 409 if the change would give the employee a second running contract.
Delete an employment contract. contract_id is required.

List employee documents. Optional filters: employee_id, document_type (national_id, passport, contract, cv, certificate, other), uploaded_by_id, expiry_date_from, expiry_date_to (YYYY-MM-DD). search: partial match on document name or employee first/last name. Pagination: page, page_size (default 10, maximum 100). Each row includes a download_url. Ordered by -uploaded_at.
Get a single document's metadata. Returns {"document": {...}} with a download_url, or 404.

Upload a document (multipart/form-data). Required: employee_id, document_type, file. Optional: document_name (defaults to the original file name), expiry_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Allowed types: pdf, doc, docx, jpg, jpeg, png; max 10 MB. The file is stored in backend/uploads/employee_documents/ with a random name; uploaded_by is set to the logged-in user.
Edit document metadata (JSON). document_id is required; send only the fields to change.
Replace the stored file (multipart/form-data). document_id and file are required; other fields optional. The old file is deleted from the server after the update succeeds.
Delete a document record and its stored file. document_id is required.
Download the stored file. document_id is required. Add inline=true to open it in the browser instead of downloading.

Read-only career history. Rows are created automatically when any employee field is edited through the admin employee PATCH (position, department, branch, status, type, manager, role, schedule, hire date, name, email, phone, address, national ID, gender, date of birth, password — password values are never stored), or a contract's wage changes (contract PATCH). Optional filters: employee_id, change_type (promotion, transfer, salary_change, status_change, position_change, other), recorded_by_id, change_date_from, change_date_to (YYYY-MM-DD). search: partial match on old/new value, notes or employee name. Pagination: page, page_size (default 10, maximum 100). Ordered by -change_date, -created_at. POST/PATCH/DELETE return 405.
Get a single history entry. Returns {"history": {...}} or 404.

List work schedules with their daily lines nested. Optional filters: active (true/false), search (partial name). Pagination: page, page_size. Each schedule includes employee_count, contract_count and lines [{line_id, weekday, weekday_label, start_time, end_time, break_minutes}] ordered Sunday first. weekday values: Saturday=0, Sunday=1, Monday=2, Tuesday=3, Wednesday=4, Thursday=5, Friday=6.
Get one schedule with its lines. Returns {"schedule": {...}} or 404.

Create a schedule, optionally with its daily lines. Required: name (unique), hours_per_week (0-168). Optional: timezone_name (IANA, default Africa/Cairo), active (default true), lines. Each line: weekday (0-6, once per schedule), start_time < end_time, 0 <= break_minutes < shift.
Update a schedule. schedule_id is required; send only the fields to change. If lines is sent it REPLACES all of the schedule's lines ([] clears them); omit it to keep the current lines.
Delete a schedule and its lines. schedule_id is required. Returns 409 with employee_count and contract_count while the schedule is still assigned; set active=false instead.

List public holidays ordered by date. Optional filters: is_recurring (true/false), date_from, date_to (YYYY-MM-DD), search (partial name). Pagination: page, page_size. is_recurring=true -> 'Recurring' (repeats every year on the same day), false -> 'Added yearly' (one-off).

item.name: Get Public Holidays for a year

request.description: All holidays that fall in a calendar year: one-off holidays dated in that year plus every recurring holiday moved to that year (occurs_on; Feb 29 -> Feb 28 in non-leap years). Sorted by occurs_on, not paginated. Can be combined with is_recurring and search.
Get one holiday. Returns {"holiday": {...}} or 404.
Create a holiday. Required: name, date (unique). Optional: is_recurring (default false).
Update a holiday. holiday_id is required; send only the fields to change.
Delete a holiday. holiday_id is required.
Leave types for the dropdown (active only; include_inactive=true for all). unit is days or hours.

Counted working days for a prospective request (weekends = days without a schedule line, default Fri/Sat; public holidays excluded, recurring ones every year), checked against the balance. Required: leave_type_id, date_from, date_to. Optional: employee_id (default: me), requested_amount (hour-based types), leave_id (when editing, so the request isn't counted against itself). Returns counted_days, weekend_days, holiday_days, holidays[], balance_remaining (null = no limit), enough_balance, overlaps. Writes nothing.

Balance panel: per leave type, allocated (approved allocations covering the date) - used (approved requests) - pending (submitted requests) = remaining. Optional: employee_id (default: me), date (default: today), leave_type_id (one type, also those without an allocation).

'My requests' table. Filters: mine=true, employee_id, leave_type_id, status (draft, submitted, approved, refused, cancelled), approver_id, to_review=true (submitted requests where I'm the approver), date_from/date_to (requests overlapping the range), search (employee name/code). Pagination: page, page_size. Ordered by -date_from.
Submitted leave requests where the logged-in user is the approver.
Get one leave request. Returns {"leave_request": {...}} or 404.

Create a draft. Required: leave_type_id, date_from, date_to. Optional: employee_id (default: me), employee_comment, approver_id (default: employee's manager; can't be the employee). requested_amount is computed for day-based types (weekends/holidays excluded) and required for hour-based types (single day). Drafts skip the balance check but not overlap.
Create and submit in one step (status=submitted): the balance is checked. Types with requires_approval=false are approved immediately.
Edit a draft or submitted request (requester or admin). leave_id is required; send only fields to change. requested_amount is recalculated and validated again.
draft -> submitted (requester or admin). The balance is checked.
submitted -> approved. Only the assigned approver or a superuser; never the requester. The balance is checked again.
submitted -> refused. Only the assigned approver or a superuser; never the requester.
draft/submitted -> cancelled (requester or admin); approved -> cancelled (requester, approver or admin), which frees the balance. Refused and cancelled are final.
Delete a draft (requester or admin). Other statuses return 409 - cancel them instead.
Every edited field is logged automatically in Employee History (GET /hr/employee-history/), with recorded_by = the logged-in admin. Password changes are logged without values.
